nodes.title: Median amplification

nodes.summary: Let `Y₁, …, Y_s` be independent real random variables, each outside `[a, b]` with probability at most `1 / 8`. Then the probability that at least half of them lie outside `[a, b]` is at most `exp (-9 s / 32)`. The proof applies Hoeffding's inequality to the indicators of the bad events (N. Alon, Y. nodes.title: At least half of independent estimates are rarely bad

nodes.summary: If fewer than half of the values `y i` lie outside `[a, b]` (that is, `2 · #{i | y i ∉ [a, b]} < s`), then the sample median lies in `[a, b]`. This is the deterministic step of the median trick (N. Alon, Y. Matias and M. Szegedy, J. Comput. System Sci. 58 (1999), proof of Theorem 2.1: "In case this does not happen, the median Yᵢ supplies a good estimate").
nodes.title: The median lies in an interval holding a strict majority

nodes.summary: For `y : Fin s → ℝ`, the least value `y j` such that more than half of the values are at most `y j`. For odd `s` this is the usual median; for even `s` it is the upper of the two middle values; for `s = 0` it is `0` by the convention `sInf ∅ = 0`.
nodes.title: Sample median

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
